nodes.label: Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.source_location: ## Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.rationale: For `flag && cheapCondition`, evaluating the synchronous guard first removes the flag-service/network/DB cost entirely on the cold path. Explicitly framed as a specialization of Defer Await Until Needed. Trade-off noted: keep the original order when the cheap condition is actually expensive, depends on the flag, or side effects must run in a fixed order.

edges.source_location: This is a specialization of [Defer Await Until Needed](./async-defer-await.md)
